user.title: Set up Essential Budget
user.description: Enter the names of the persons sharing the budget; leave the second name empty for a budget of one person. Income and fixed costs are edited on the edit page afterwards (gear icon of the budget card or of the integration entry). The data is saved in .storage/essential_budget.json in your config folder.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Essential Budget is already set up

invalid_file.title: Budget file could not be read
invalid_file.description:
{file} could not be read: {error}

Fix the file (or restore it from a backup) and restart Home Assistant. Until then the budget card shows an error and nothing can be saved, so the file is not overwritten.
